name: Impeccable
description: Gives coding agents a frontend design skill with 24 /impeccable commands, plus a CLI and Chrome extension that flag common AI-generated design patterns using 61 deterministic rules.

skills.name: Design Commands
skills.description: Adds 24 /impeccable commands such as craft, shape, audit, critique, polish and harden for planning, reviewing and refining frontend UI.

skills.name: Anti-Pattern Detector
skills.description: Scans files, folders or live URLs with npx impeccable detect, running 61 deterministic rules with no LLM or API key, with JSON output for CI.

skills.name: Live Variant Mode
skills.description: Iterates on page elements in the browser with /impeccable live and generate, producing design variants of a named element.

skills.name: Product Context Setup
skills.description: Runs /impeccable init to inspect the project, ask only about material gaps, and record audience, purpose and constraints in PRODUCT.md.

skills.name: Chrome DevTools Panel
skills.description: Finds design issues on a rendered page from an Impeccable panel in Chrome DevTools, using the same deterministic detector rules.
